title: 2020-21 Panini Prizm Pink Ice #100 Victor Oladipo Indiana Pacers /50
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText:
This 2020-21 Panini Prizm sports trading card features Victor Oladipo, player/athlete for the Indiana Pacers in the National Basketball Association (NBA). The card is an original, not a reprint, and belongs to the Pink Ice parallel/variety with a print run of /50. 

The card number is 100 and it is part of the 2020-21 set manufactured by Panini. This trading card is perfect for any basketball fan or collector looking for a unique addition to their collection.
